I've some suggestions for the makers of this movie which may apply for even upcoming movies of Stree Universe.

1. Firstly, movie should've been a bit shorter. Alok should've become Betal in the initial half an hour. 

2. Dose of love was okay since love was the most important part of this movie but then it fails to land bcoz there isn't any scene that wreches your heart.
Death of Alok should've felt heavier. Rather it seemed as if it just happened. 

3. Fight of Alok and Yakshan should've been a longer one bcoz that was the only good part of the movie but it lasted for hardly 2-3 minutes. If you're building up such a strong villain then let him cook. 

4. Also, what was Yakshasan's character doing? It was cheap comedy throughout which didn't land at all. Rathet it should've been a total gruesome character. It's not that difficult to show such a character without being A rated. Watch Marvel for the same.

5. The only good thing was setting up Bhediya and Thama properly for the next movie and I hope you guys bring out your A game in that. 

6. Overall, a brilliant movie that failed to have an impact due to poor direction and carelessly written cringe dialogues.

For future movies:-
1. Keep script tighter without unnecessary efforts of forced comedy.
2. Keep fight scenes longer bcoz that's what audience expects. 
3. Put better efforts into dialogue writing which could make us feel the weight and depth of the said dialogues.
